description: Header file defining functions and macros for configuring hostapd settings, including creation, update, and configuration hash generation.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_create
methods.description: Creates a hostapd configuration file for a given radio and filename.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_createExt
methods.description: Creates an extended hostapd configuration file for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_update
methods.description: Updates a specific key-value pair in the hostapd configuration at a given path.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_setRadioConfig
methods.description: Sets radio configuration parameters in the hostapd configuration.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_setVapConfig
methods.description: Sets VAP (Virtual Access Point) configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_genConfigHash
methods.description: Generates a hash string representing the current configuration map.
